sharedAbilities.name: Disparate Paths
sharedAbilities.description: When mustering your army, you can include Harlequins units in your army, even though they do not have the Asuryani Faction keyword. Unless otherwise stated, you cannot select HARLEQUINS or Ynnari as your Army Faction.

sharedAbilities.name: Corsairs and Travelling Players
sharedAbilities.description:
If your Army Faction is DRUKHARI, you can include Harlequins and Anhrathe units in your army, even though they do not have the DRUKHARI Faction keyword. The combined points value of HARLEQUINS and/or ANHRATHE units you can include in your army depends on the battle size, as follows:
• Incursion: Up to 250 pts
• Strike Force: Up to 500 pts
• Onslaught: Up to 750 pts

No HARLEQUINS or ANHRATHE models included in your army in this way can be your WARLORD, and they cannot be given Enhancements.

sharedAbilities.name: Thrill Seekers
sharedAbilities.legend: The Emperor’s Children are skilled warriors all, their transhuman might enhanced by a lifetime of ceaseless conflict. Their ingrained desire for sensation in all its forms sees them move rapidly across the battlefield, flitting between targets as they attempt to satiate their never-ending hunger for fresh experience.
sharedAbilities.description:
If your Army Faction is Emperor’s Children, this unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, but when doing so:
• It cannot target a unit it was within Engagement Range of at the start of the turn.
• It cannot target a unit that was the target of another units charge or attack this phase.

sharedAbilities.name: Pact of Excess
sharedAbilities.legend: By enacting the most lurid and excessive acts of ritual violence, the Emperor’s Children may shatter reality itself and summon forth the daemons of Slaanesh.
sharedAbilities.description: When mustering your army, unless specifically stated otherwise, you cannot select Legions of Excess as your Army Faction.

sharedAbilities.name: Pact of Blood
sharedAbilities.legend: Through acts of frenzied violence and unbound savagery, the World Eaters may open a rent in reality, allowing the daemons of Khorne to spill forth from that infernal domain.
sharedAbilities.description: When mustering your army, unless specifically stated otherwise, you cannot select Blood Legions as your Army Faction.

sharedAbilities.name: Pact of Decay
sharedAbilities.legend: The daemons of Nurgle are not native to realspace, but instead must be summoned through the rotting veil by way of generous sacrifice and acts of foul worship.
sharedAbilities.description: When mustering your army, unless specifically stated otherwise, you cannot select Plague Legions as your Army Faction.

sharedAbilities.name: Pact of Sorcery
sharedAbilities.legend: The daemons of Tzeentch are drawn through the barriers of the Warp by rituals of transmutation.
sharedAbilities.description: When mustering your army, unless specifically stated otherwise, you cannot select Scintillating Legions as your Army Faction.

sharedAbilities.name: Curse of the Wulfen
sharedAbilities.legend: Only while fighting at the side of their battle-brothers can the feral Wulfen control their frenzied aggression.
sharedAbilities.description:
While this unit is within 6" of a friendly SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER model (excluding WULFEN models) or within 12" of a friendly WOLF PRIEST model, if this unit is not battle-shocked:
• If this unit has INFANTRY, this unit has +1 OC.
• If this unit has VEHICLE, this unit has +3 OC.
Bestial Forms: For the purposes of transport capacity, each WULFEN model takes up the space of 2 models.

sharedAbilities.name: Sons of Russ
sharedAbilities.description: Your army cannot include APOTHECARY units.

sharedAbilities.name: Gate of Infinity
sharedAbilities.legend: Few can command the powers of the Warp with anything like the skill and control of the Grey Knights. So masterful is their sorcery that they can conjure glowing empyric gateways to step in and out of reality. In this way, they swiftly outflank their foes and redeploy their forces to counter threats, kept safe during their split-second Warp travel by the intricate wards worked into their wargear.
sharedAbilities.description:
If your Army Faction is GREY KNIGHTS, at the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, you can select a number of units (see below) from your army that are on the battlefield (excluding units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units), provided every model in those units has this ability. The maximum number of units you can select depends on the battle size, as follows:

BATTLE SIZENUMBER OF UNITSIncursionUp to 2 unitsStrike ForceUp to 3 unitsOnslaughtUp to 4 units

• Place those units in strategic reserves.
• Those units can make an ingress move in your next Movement phase (including in your first turn).

sharedAbilities.name: Heirs of Sigismund
sharedAbilities.description:
• Your army cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER models.
• Your army cannot include the following datasheets from Codex: Space Marines: GLADIATOR LANCER; GLADIATOR REAPER; GLADIATOR VALIANT; IMPULSOR; REPULSOR; REPULSOR EXECUTIONER.

sharedAbilities.name: Prioritised Efficiency
sharedAbilities.legend: As the Kin truth describes, Luck has. Need keeps. Toil earns. The kinhost’s ability to efficiently switch its strategic footing embodies this wisdom. It results from swift assessments of a foe’s possessions, how best to seize them for the kindred’s need and then to stubbornly toil to hold them against counterattacks.
sharedAbilities.description:
If your Army Faction is LEAGUES OF VOTANN, Leagues of Votann units from your army have one of two abilities: Hostile Acquisition or Fortify Takeover (see below). During the battle, which ability those LEAGUES OF VOTANN units have will change depending on how many Yield points (YP) you currently have:
• At the start of the battle, your units have Hostile Acquisition until the start of your next Command phase.
• At the end of your Command phase, if you have fewer than 7YP, your units have Hostile Acquisition until the start of your next Command phase.
• At the end of your Command phase, if you have 7YP or more, your units have Fortify Takeover until the start of your next Command phase.

Hostile Acquisition
• Each time a model in this unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of one or more objective markers, add 1 to the Hit roll.
• You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for this unit.

Fortify Takeover
• Each time a model in this unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, if this unit is within range of one or more objective markers you control, add 1 to the Hit roll.
• Each time an attack targets this unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than this unit’s Toughness characteristic and this unit is not a VEHICLE, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Yield Points
At the end of each player’s Command phase, you gain 1YP if you control one or more objective markers within your deployment zone, and, from the second battle round onwards, you gain 1 additional YP for each of the following conditions you satisfy:
• You control one or more objective markers not within your deployment zone.
• You control two or more objective markers not within your deployment zone.
• You control more objective markers than your opponent.

In your turn, YP gained in this way are always gained before checking which ability LEAGUES OF VOTANN units from your army have.

Whenever a rule allows you to spend YP, reduce the number of YP you have by that amount (your YP cannot go below 0), otherwise you cannot use that rule.

Designer’s Note: This means you can use rules that let you gain or spend YP to influence which ability your units have - Hostile Acquisition or Fortify Takeover - depending on which will be most beneficial to you. Remember that your army only changes ability at the end of your Command phase, so you will - sometimes need to plan ahead if you want your army to stay in or change ability.

Example: In her third turn, Freida’s units had the Hostile Acquisition ability, as she had 6YP at the end of her Command phase. In her fourth turn, at the end of her Command phase, she controls one objective marker within her deployment zone, and one objective marker not within her deployment zone, and her opponent controls two objective markers. Freida gains 2YP, so she now has 8YP, and her units now have the Fortify Takeover ability instead.

During her turn, Freida uses a Stratagem that allows her to spend YP. She spends 2YP, bringing her total down to 6YP. However, units from her army still have Fortify Takeover - it will only change if, at the end of her next Command phase, she still has fewer than 7YP.

sharedAbilities.name: Super-heavy Walker
sharedAbilities.legend: Monstrous creatures and gigantic engines of war loom over the battlefield like gods given form, striding over combatants and smashing through almost any obstacle that bars their passage.
sharedAbilities.description:
Each time a unit with this ability makes a normal, advance or fall-back move:
• Models in that unit can move through models (including MONSTER/VEHICLE models, but excluding TITANIC models) and can move horizontally through sections of terrain features that are 4" or less in height.
• Before moving that unit, you can select for all models in that unit to have the MOBILE keyword until that move ends. If you do, when that move ends, roll one D6: on a 1, that unit is battle-shocked.

Designer’s Note: Gaining the MOBILE keyword for the duration of a move will enable models in that unit to move horizontally through dense terrain features (13.06).

sharedAbilities.name: Support
sharedAbilities.legend: Specialist combatants may be assigned to front-line squads to bolster their fighting effectiveness.
sharedAbilities.description:
Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it.

Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it.

sharedAbilities.name: Damaged
sharedAbilities.description: This ability always takes the form Damaged X. While a model’s remaining wounds are equal to or less than X, that model is damaged: while damaged, that model’s attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

sharedAbilities.name: Da Boss
sharedAbilities.legend: Whether capable of kunnin’ strategy or favouring something far less complicated, the biggest Ork tends to have a voice as aggressive and brutal as the rest of him. His bellows can be heard over the thickest fighting and his reputation ensures the ladz do as they’re told.
sharedAbilities.description: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

sharedAbilities.name: Unstable Energies
sharedAbilities.legend: Ork psykers – Weirdboyz and their unsavoury ilk – release the painful build-up of Waaagh! energy in sudden discharges of power, usually with spectacularly lethal results.
sharedAbilities.description:
Orks Psyker units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit’s abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability’s name.

In a battle round, a friendly ORKS PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit’s psyker level.

Example: In a battle round, a psyker level 3 PSYKER unit could use three psychic level 1abilities, or one psychic level 1 ability and one psychic level 2 ability, or one psychic level 3 ability.

sharedAbilities.name: Special Move Types
sharedAbilities.description:
The following are special move types that certain or all of your units are eligible to make.

PULSE JET MOVE

MAXIMUM DISTANCE: Pulse roll + 18"

ELIGIBLE IF: As stated in the rule allowing this move type.

EFFECT: Your unit moves as described in Moving (Core Rules, 03).

BEFORE MOVING:
• Make a pulse roll by rolling one D6.

WHILE MOVING:
• Ignore all vertical distance for the purposes of how far your unit has moved.
• Your unit can move through all types of model.
• Your unit can move horizontally and vertically through all categories of terrain feature.

AFTER MOVING:
• Your unit must be unengaged.
• Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or start an action.
• Until the start of your next turn, attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

ASSAULT DISEMBARK MOVE

SET-UP DISTANCE: 3"

ELIGIBLE IF:
• Embarked within a TRANSPORT on the battlefield
• Did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase
• That TRANSPORT has not made an advance/fall-back move this phase

EFFECT: Set up as described in Set Up (03.02).

WHILE MOVING: Set up each model wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.

sharedAbilities.name: Combat Doctrines
sharedAbilities.legend: The Space Marines draw upon the combat doctrines of the Codex Astartes as they flow through each phase of battle: first hammering the enemy with devastating firepower, then raking them with close-ranged volleys while manoeuvring to deliver a final, crushing assault.
sharedAbilities.description:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one combat doctrine listed below. If you do, that combat doctrine is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.

ASSAULT DOCTRINEWhen this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

DEVASTATOR DOCTRINEThis unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

TACTICAL DOCTRINEWhen this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge.
Unless otherwise stated:
• You can only select each combat doctrine once per battle.
• Only one combat doctrine can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a combat doctrine active for a unit, any combat doctrine previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

sharedAbilities.name: Assault Doctrine
sharedAbilities.description: When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

sharedAbilities.name: Devastator Doctrine
sharedAbilities.description: This unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

sharedAbilities.name: Tactical Doctrine
sharedAbilities.description: When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge.

sharedAbilities.name: Transhuman Strategist
sharedAbilities.legend: Those Space Marines who rise to positions of command are exceptional strategists and tacticians.
sharedAbilities.description: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

sharedAbilities.name: Librarius
sharedAbilities.legend: Space Marine Librarians advance through the ranks of Lexicanum, then Codicier, then Epistolary, their psychic might and repertoire of powers increasing with their hardwon experience.
sharedAbilities.description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit’s abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability’s name.

In a battle round, a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit’s psyker level.

Example: In a battle round, a psyker level 3 PSYKER unit could use three psychic level 1 abilities, or one psychic level 1 ability and one psychic level 2 ability, or one psychic level 3 ability.

sharedAbilities.name: Special Move Types
sharedAbilities.description:
The following are special move types that certain or all of your units are eligible to make.

SHOCK DISEMBARK MOVE

SET-UP DISTANCE: 3"

ELIGIBLE IF:
• Embarked within a TRANSPORT on the battlefield
• Did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase

EFFECT: Set up as described in Set Up (03.02).

WHILE MOVING: Set up each model wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.

AFTER MOVING: Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

ASSAULT DISEMBARK MOVE

SET-UP DISTANCE: 3"

ELIGIBLE IF:
• Embarked within a TRANSPORT on the battlefield
• Did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase
• That TRANSPORT has not made an advance/fall-back move this phase

EFFECT: Set up as described in Set Up (03.02).

WHILE MOVING: Set up each model wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.

sharedAbilities.name: Veteran Recruits
sharedAbilities.description:
Your army cannot include the following ADEPTUS ASTARTES units:
• SCOUT SQUAD units.
• TERMINATOR SQUAD units.
• TERMINATOR ASSAULT SQUAD units.

sharedAbilities.name: Daughters of the Abyss
sharedAbilities.legend: Bearers of the Pariah gene, Null Maidens are inured to psychic powers. Their Warp-smothering aura also provides limited protection for the Custodians at whose side they fight.
sharedAbilities.description:
• Friendly Anathema Psykana units with this ability have Feel No Pain 3+ against psychic attacks.
• Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units with this ability have the following ability:
Psychic Null (Aura): Friendly Adeptus Custodes units within 6" of this unit have Feel No Pain 5+ against psychic attacks.

sharedAbilities.name: Anathema Psykana
sharedAbilities.legend: Though the Adeptus Custodes often fight alongside the Silent Sisterhood, they take orders only from their own commanders, or from the Emperor Himself.
sharedAbilities.description:
You can include Anathema Psykana units in your army, even though they do not have the Adeptus Custodes faction keyword.

When mustering your army, unless otherwise stated:
• You cannot select ANATHEMA PSYKANA as your army faction.
• You cannot select an ANATHEMA PSYKANA model to be your WARLORD.

sharedAbilities.name: Special Move Types
sharedAbilities.description:
The following are special move types that certain or all of your units are eligible to make.

SHOCK DISEMBARK MOVE

SET-UP DISTANCE: 3"

ELIGIBLE IF:
• Embarked within a TRANSPORT on the battlefield
• Did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase

EFFECT: Set up as described in Set Up (03.02).

WHILE MOVING: Set up each model wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.

AFTER MOVING: Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

sharedAbilities.name: Aquila Commander
sharedAbilities.legend: Shield-Captains who bear the title Aquila Commander have proven themselves true masters of battlefield tactics.
sharedAbilities.description: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

sharedAbilities.name: Aegis of the Emperor
sharedAbilities.legend: The Adeptus Custodes are the shield of the Emperor: indomitable and nigh unbreakable.
sharedAbilities.description: Friendly Adeptus Custodes units with this ability have Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

keywordGlossary.name: Close-Quarters
keywordGlossary.summary: Can be selected to shoot even if the bearer’s unit is Engaged (replaces 10th Ed Pistol for point-blank shooting).
keywordGlossary.description: Weapons with [CLOSE-QUARTERS] in their profile are designed for point-blank firefights. When a unit is Engaged in combat, models in that unit can select [CLOSE-QUARTERS] weapons to shoot at enemy units they are engaged with in the Shooting phase (without the -1 Hit roll penalty suffered by non-[CLOSE-QUARTERS] weapons on Monsters and Vehicles).

keywordGlossary.name: Assault
keywordGlossary.summary: Can be shot even if the bearer’s unit Advanced.
keywordGlossary.description: Weapons with [ASSAULT] in their profile are known as Assault weapons. If a unit that Advanced this turn contains any models equipped with Assault weapons, it is still eligible to shoot in this turn’s Shooting phase (including via the 11th Edition Snap Shooting core action), but when it does, models in that unit can only make attacks with Assault weapons they are equipped with.

keywordGlossary.name: Heavy
keywordGlossary.summary: +1 to Hit rolls if the bearer’s unit Remained Stationary or moved 3" or less.
keywordGlossary.description: Weapons with [HEAVY] in their profile are known as Heavy weapons. In 11th Edition, each time an attack is made with such a weapon, if the attacking model’s unit Remained Stationary or made a move of 3" or less (e.g. pivoting / bracing) this turn, add 1 to the Hit roll.

keywordGlossary.name: Rapid Fire X
keywordGlossary.summary: Increase the Attacks characteristic by X when targeting units within half range.
keywordGlossary.description: Weapons with [RAPID FIRE X] in their profile are known as Rapid Fire weapons. Each time such a weapon targets a unit within half of the weapon’s maximum range, the Attacks characteristic of that weapon is increased by X.

keywordGlossary.name: Pistol
keywordGlossary.summary: Can be shot while within Engagement Range of enemy units (must target that enemy unit).
keywordGlossary.description: Weapons with [PISTOL] in their profile are known as Pistols. If a unit is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it is eligible to shoot in its controlling player’s Shooting phase using Pistols, targeting one of those enemy units. A model cannot shoot both Pistols and non-Pistol ranged weapons in the same phase (unless it is a Monster or Vehicle).

keywordGlossary.name: Torrent
keywordGlossary.summary: Attacks automatically hit the target (no Hit roll required).
keywordGlossary.description: Weapons with [TORRENT] in their profile are known as Torrent weapons. Each time an attack is made with such a weapon, that attack automatically hits the target (including during Fire Overwatch).

keywordGlossary.name: Lethal Hits
keywordGlossary.summary: Critical Hits (unmodified Hit roll of 6) automatically wound the target.
keywordGlossary.description: Weapons with [LETHAL HITS] in their profile are known as Lethal Hits weapons. Each time an attack is made with such a weapon, a Critical Hit automatically wounds the target (do not make a Wound roll). Note: some 11th Edition profiles feature conditional Lethal Hits (e.g. [LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE]).

keywordGlossary.name: Sustained Hits X
keywordGlossary.summary: Critical Hits (unmodified Hit roll of 6) score X additional hits.
keywordGlossary.description: Weapons with [SUSTAINED HITS X] in their profile cause X additional hits on the target each time an attack scores a Critical Hit.

keywordGlossary.name: Devastating Wounds
keywordGlossary.summary: Critical Wounds inflict mortal wounds or bypass armor/invulnerable saves.
keywordGlossary.description: Each time an attack is made with a [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] weapon, if that attack scores a Critical Wound, no saving throw of any kind can be made against that attack (including invulnerable saves). The damage is applied directly to the target unit (Feel No Pain rolls can still be made).

keywordGlossary.name: Twin-linked
keywordGlossary.summary: You can re-roll the Wound roll for attacks made with this weapon.
keywordGlossary.description: Weapons with [TWIN-LINKED] in their profile allow you to re-roll the Wound roll each time an attack is made with that weapon.

keywordGlossary.name: Blast X
keywordGlossary.summary: +X Attacks per 5 models in the target unit. Cannot target units in Engagement Range of friendly units.
keywordGlossary.description: In 11th Edition, weapons with [BLAST X] (or standard [BLAST]) add X Attacks (defaulting to 1) for every 5 models in the target unit (rounding down). Blast weapons can never be used to make attacks against a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more units from the attacking model’s army.

keywordGlossary.name: Cleave X
keywordGlossary.summary: 11th Edition melee ability: on critical wound or hit, improves AP or deals extra sweeping damage.
keywordGlossary.description: Weapons with [CLEAVE X] are specialized 11th Edition close-combat weapons (such as Choppas, Power Klaws, and heavy blades) designed to hack through multiple combatants or slice through heavy armor.

keywordGlossary.name: Conversion
keywordGlossary.summary: Long-range critical hits: attacks targeting units beyond 12" (or 24") score Critical Hits on unmodified 4+.
keywordGlossary.description: Weapons with [CONVERSION] focus matter-disrupting beams. Each time an attack is made with this weapon targeting a unit beyond its minimum bracket (typically more than 12" or 24" away), an unmodified successful Hit roll of 4+ scores a Critical Hit.

keywordGlossary.name: Melta X
keywordGlossary.summary: Increase the Damage characteristic by X when targeting units within half range.
keywordGlossary.description: Each time an attack made with a [MELTA X] weapon targets a unit within half of that weapon’s range, the Damage characteristic of that attack is increased by X.

keywordGlossary.name: Hazardous
keywordGlossary.summary: After shooting or fighting, roll 1D6 per Hazardous weapon used; on a 1, suffer 3 mortal wounds (or destroy 1 non-Character/Vehicle/Monster model).
keywordGlossary.description: After a unit shoots or fights, roll one Hazardous test (1D6) for each [HAZARDOUS] weapon used. For each roll of 1, one model equipped with a Hazardous weapon is destroyed (Characters, Monsters, and Vehicles suffer 3 mortal wounds instead).

keywordGlossary.name: Precision
keywordGlossary.summary: When targeting an Attached unit, the attacking player can allocate successful wounds directly to a visible attached Character model.
keywordGlossary.description: Each time an attack made with a [PRECISION] weapon successfully wounds an Attached unit, if a Character model in that unit is visible to the attacking model, the attacking player can choose to have that attack allocated to that Character model instead of following the normal attack allocation sequence.

keywordGlossary.name: Indirect Fire
keywordGlossary.summary: Can target units that are not visible to the bearer (unmodified 1-3 to Hit fails; target gains Benefit of Cover if not visible).
keywordGlossary.description: Weapons with [INDIRECT FIRE] can target and make attacks against units that are not visible to the attacking unit. If no models in a target unit are visible when selected, subtract 1 from the Hit roll, unmodified Hit rolls of 1–3 always fail, and the target has the Benefit of Cover against those attacks.

keywordGlossary.name: Ignores Cover
keywordGlossary.summary: Target cannot have the Benefit of Cover against attacks made with this weapon.
keywordGlossary.description: Each time an attack is made with an [IGNORES COVER] weapon, the target cannot have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

keywordGlossary.name: Lance
keywordGlossary.summary: +1 to Wound rolls if the bearer made a Charge move this turn.
keywordGlossary.description: Each time an attack is made with a [LANCE] weapon, if the bearer’s unit made a Charge move this turn, add 1 to that attack’s Wound roll.

keywordGlossary.name: Extra Attacks
keywordGlossary.summary: Bearer can attack with this melee weapon in addition to its primary melee weapon.
keywordGlossary.description: Each time the bearer of an [EXTRA ATTACKS] weapon fights, it can make attacks with that weapon in addition to the one melee weapon it selects to fight with. The number of attacks made with an Extra Attacks weapon cannot be modified by other rules.

keywordGlossary.name: One Shot
keywordGlossary.summary: The bearer can only shoot with this weapon once per battle.
keywordGlossary.description: The bearer can only shoot with a [ONE SHOT] weapon once per battle. Use the One Shot checkbox on the unit card to track when it has been fired.

keywordGlossary.name: Anti-Keyword X+
keywordGlossary.summary: An unmodified Wound roll of X+ against a target with the matching keyword scores a Critical Wound.
keywordGlossary.description: Each time an attack is made with an [ANTI-KEYWORD X+] weapon against a target with the matching keyword, an unmodified Wound roll of X+ scores a Critical Wound (which always wounds, and triggers Devastating Wounds if also present).

keywordGlossary.name: Psychic
keywordGlossary.summary: Attacks and abilities tagged with Psychic are Psychic Attacks (triggers Feel No Pain vs Psychic).
keywordGlossary.description: Any weapon or ability with the [PSYCHIC] tag counts as a Psychic Attack. Wounds inflicted by Psychic Attacks can be resisted by rules that grant Feel No Pain against Psychic Attacks.

keywordGlossary.name: Piercing
keywordGlossary.summary: 11th Edition weapon rule improving Armor Penetration on critical rolls or specific conditions.
keywordGlossary.description: Weapons with [PIERCING] improve the Armour Penetration (AP) characteristic of their attacks according to their profile parameter.

keywordGlossary.name: Deep Strike
keywordGlossary.summary: Can be set up in Reserves and arrive in the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase (>9" from enemies).
keywordGlossary.description: During the Declare Battle Formations step, if every model in a unit has this ability, you can set it up in Reserves instead of on the battlefield. In the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase (Battle Round 2+), set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy models.

keywordGlossary.name: Scouts X"
keywordGlossary.summary: Before the first turn begins, can make a Normal move of up to X" (must end >9" from enemy models).
keywordGlossary.description: If every model in a unit has this ability, at the start of the first battle round, before the first turn begins, it can make a Normal move of up to X" as if it were your Movement phase (including Dedicated Transports they are embarked within). Must end more than 9" horizontally from all enemy models.

keywordGlossary.name: Infiltrators
keywordGlossary.summary: During deployment, can be set up anywhere on the battlefield >9" from the enemy deployment zone and enemy models.
keywordGlossary.description: During deployment, if every model in a unit has this ability, when you set it up, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from the enemy deployment zone and all enemy models.

keywordGlossary.name: Feel No Pain X+
keywordGlossary.summary: Each time a model in this unit would lose a wound, roll 1D6; on X+, that wound is not lost.
keywordGlossary.description: Each time a model with Feel No Pain X+ would lose a wound (including from mortal wounds or Devastating Wounds), roll one D6: if the result equals or exceeds X+, that wound is not lost.

keywordGlossary.name: Fights First
keywordGlossary.summary: Fights in the Fights First step of the Fight phase (before Remaining Combats).
keywordGlossary.description: Units with this ability that are eligible to fight do so in the Fights First step of the Fight phase, alternating activations starting with the player whose turn is not taking place.

keywordGlossary.name: Lone Operative
keywordGlossary.summary: Unless part of an Attached unit, cannot be targeted by ranged attacks from more than 12" away.
keywordGlossary.description: Unless part of an Attached unit, this unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 12".

keywordGlossary.name: Stealth
keywordGlossary.summary: Subtract 1 from the Hit roll for ranged attacks targeting this unit.
keywordGlossary.description: If every model in a unit has this ability, each time a ranged attack is made against it, subtract 1 from that attack’s Hit roll.

keywordGlossary.name: Deadly Demise X
keywordGlossary.summary: When destroyed, roll 1D6; on a 6, each unit within 6" suffers X mortal wounds.
keywordGlossary.description: When this model is destroyed, roll one D6 before removing it from play. On a 6, each unit within 6" suffers X mortal wounds.

keywordGlossary.name: Leader
keywordGlossary.summary: Can be attached to an eligible Bodyguard unit during the Declare Battle Formations step.
keywordGlossary.description: In 11th Edition, a Bodyguard unit can have at most 1 Regular Leader and 1 Support Character (`is_support`) attached to it during Pre-game setup. While leading a unit, they form a single Attached unit for all rules except when destroyed.

keywordGlossary.name: Firing Deck X
keywordGlossary.summary: Up to X embarked models can have 1 ranged weapon selected for the Transport to shoot with.
keywordGlossary.description: Each time this Transport shoots in the Shooting phase, you can select one ranged weapon from up to X models embarked within it; the Transport counts as being equipped with those weapons in addition to its own.

keywordGlossary.name: Hover
keywordGlossary.summary: Aircraft can declare Hover mode in Pre-game: loses Aircraft, Move becomes 20", starts on battlefield.
keywordGlossary.description: During Declare Battle Formations, you can declare this Aircraft is in Hover mode: its Move characteristic becomes 20", it loses the Aircraft keyword and all Aircraft rules, and it can be deployed on the battlefield in Round 1.

keywordGlossary.name: Damaged Bracket
keywordGlossary.summary: While this Vehicle or Monster is at or below its wound threshold, subtract 1 from its Hit rolls.
keywordGlossary.description: Many large Vehicles and Monsters suffer a Damaged penalty (typically -1 to Hit rolls, and sometimes reduced Objective Control) once their remaining Wounds fall into their Damaged bracket.

keywordGlossary.name: Infantry
keywordGlossary.summary: Can move freely through Ruins walls, embark in standard Transports, and perform Infantry actions.
keywordGlossary.description: Infantry models can move through Ruins terrain features (walls, floors, and windows) without penalty, gain the Benefit of Cover easily, and are affected by Anti-Infantry weapons.

keywordGlossary.name: Character
keywordGlossary.summary: Heroic commander or specialist; eligible for Enhancements, Heroic Intervention, and vulnerable to [PRECISION].
keywordGlossary.description: Character units can be given Detachment Enhancements (max 1 per Character, up to 3 per army). When attached to a Bodyguard unit, enemy attacks with [PRECISION] can allocate wounds directly to visible Character models.

keywordGlossary.name: Epic Hero
keywordGlossary.summary: Named legendary character: max 1 of each Epic Hero per army; cannot be given Enhancements.
keywordGlossary.description: Your army cannot include the same Epic Hero more than once, and Epic Hero models cannot be given any Enhancements.

keywordGlossary.name: Battleline
keywordGlossary.summary: Core troops choice: you can include up to 6 copies of each Battleline datasheet in your army.
keywordGlossary.description: Unlike standard datasheets (limited to 3 copies), an army can include up to 6 units of each Battleline datasheet (and up to 6 Dedicated Transports). Often receives special mission bonuses.

keywordGlossary.name: Dedicated Transport
keywordGlossary.summary: Must start the battle with at least one friendly unit embarked within it, or it counts as destroyed.
keywordGlossary.description: You can include up to 6 Dedicated Transports of the same datasheet. Every Dedicated Transport must start the battle with at least one unit embarked within it, or it is destroyed at the start of the first battle round.

keywordGlossary.name: Vehicle
keywordGlossary.summary: Can shoot into and out of Engagement Range (Big Guns Never Tire, -1 to Hit) and use Tank Shock.
keywordGlossary.description: Vehicles are eligible to shoot in their Shooting phase even while within Engagement Range of enemy units (and enemy units can shoot at Vehicles that are in Engagement Range) with a -1 Hit penalty via Big Guns Never Tire. Cannot move through Ruins walls unless Titanic/specific rules apply.

keywordGlossary.name: Monster
keywordGlossary.summary: Can shoot into and out of Engagement Range (Big Guns Never Tire, -1 to Hit).
keywordGlossary.description: Monsters are eligible to shoot in their Shooting phase even while within Engagement Range of enemy units (and enemy units can shoot at Monsters that are in Engagement Range) with a -1 Hit penalty via Big Guns Never Tire.

keywordGlossary.name: Mounted
keywordGlossary.summary: Fast cavalry/bikers: moves around Ruins walls; interacts with Anti-Mounted rules.
keywordGlossary.description: Mounted units represent bikers and cavalry. Unlike Infantry, they cannot move straight through solid Ruins walls, but often boast high Movement and Lance/Charge synergies.

keywordGlossary.name: Beast
keywordGlossary.summary: Fast creatures that can move through Ruins walls just like Infantry.
keywordGlossary.description: Beast models can move through Ruins walls and floors freely just like Infantry.

keywordGlossary.name: Swarm
keywordGlossary.summary: Small creatures that can move through Ruins walls; typically OC 0 and cannot hold objectives alone.
keywordGlossary.description: Swarm models can move through Ruins terrain freely like Infantry, though they usually have an Objective Control (OC) characteristic of 0.

keywordGlossary.name: Fly
keywordGlossary.summary: Can move over enemy models and terrain (measuring diagonal distance through the air when crossing tall terrain).
keywordGlossary.description: Models with FLY can move over enemy models when making a Normal, Advance, Fall Back, or Charge move. Vulnerable to [ANTI-FLY] weapons.

keywordGlossary.name: Walker
keywordGlossary.summary: Bipedal/multi-legged Vehicle (e.g. Dreadnoughts) eligible for Heroic Intervention and melee stratagems.
keywordGlossary.description: Walkers are Vehicles that fight on foot in close combat and can use several melee-oriented Stratagems and Heroic Intervention.

keywordGlossary.name: Titanic
keywordGlossary.summary: Super-heavy unit: cannot Fire Overwatch; can move over low terrain features and Fall Back + Shoot in some detachments.
keywordGlossary.description: Titanic units are massive war machines. They cannot be targeted by the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, and follow special visibility and movement rules over low obstacles.

keywordGlossary.name: Towering
keywordGlossary.summary: Massive stature: follows special Ruins visibility rules when toeing into terrain.
keywordGlossary.description: Towering models can see through Ruins terrain features even when only partially within them, and can be seen in return.

keywordGlossary.name: Aircraft
keywordGlossary.summary: Must start in Reserves (unless Hovering), moves minimum 20" straight ahead, and only interacts with FLY units in melee.
keywordGlossary.description: Aircraft start in Strategic Reserves (arriving Round 2+), must pivot up to 90° and move at least 20" straight forward, and can only be charged by units with FLY.

keywordGlossary.name: Transport
keywordGlossary.summary: Can embark friendly Infantry/eligible models up to its Transport capacity.
keywordGlossary.description: Friendly units can embark within this Transport if they end a Normal, Advance, or Fall Back move wholly within 3" of it. Disembarking units cannot Charge in the same turn if the Transport already moved (unless it has Assault Ramp).

keywordGlossary.name: Explosives
keywordGlossary.summary: 11th Edition unit keyword: specialized demolitionists/ordnance-bearers with access to ordnance core actions and explosive buffs.
keywordGlossary.description: In 11th Edition, the EXPLOSIVES keyword is given to units armed with heavy charges, satchel bombs, or combat grenades (e.g. Intercessors, Krieg Engineers, Ork Tankbustas). It governs interaction with ordnance Stratagems and demolition actions against fortifications and terrain.

keywordGlossary.name: Mobile
keywordGlossary.summary: 11th Edition keyword: allows models to move horizontally through dense terrain features without penalty.
keywordGlossary.description: In 11th Edition, units with the MOBILE keyword (or units that gain it via abilities such as Super-heavy Walker) can move horizontally through sections of dense terrain features that are 4" or less in height as if they were clear ground.

keywordGlossary.name: Frame
keywordGlossary.summary: 11th Edition light-vehicle chassis keyword for buggies, sentinels, and light war-engines.
keywordGlossary.description: Denotes light vehicle and walker chassis (such as Ork Buggies and Scout Walkers), interacting with transport capacities and repair subroutines.

keywordGlossary.name: Wagon
keywordGlossary.summary: 11th Edition heavy armored vehicle/transport keyword for battlewagons and tanks.
keywordGlossary.description: Denotes heavy battle tanks and ram-equipped transports, unlocking ramming attacks and enhanced capacity bonuses.

keywordGlossary.name: Mob
keywordGlossary.summary: 11th Edition mass infantry formation: gains morale buffs and swarm bonuses when above starting strength thresholds.
keywordGlossary.description: Units with the MOB keyword represent vast throngs of infantry (such as Ork Boyz and Gretchin) that benefit from swarm combat rules and modified Battle-shock tests.

keywordGlossary.name: Grenades
keywordGlossary.summary: Unlocks the Core "Grenade" Stratagem (1 CP in your Shooting phase: roll 6D6 within 8" for mortal wounds on 4+).
keywordGlossary.description: Units with the GRENADES keyword can use the Core Grenade Stratagem (1 CP) in your Shooting phase if they have not shot and are not in Engagement Range: select one visible enemy unit within 8" and roll six D6; for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

keywordGlossary.name: Smoke
keywordGlossary.summary: Unlocks the Core "Smokescreen" Stratagem (1 CP in Opponent’s Shooting phase: grants Benefit of Cover and Stealth).
keywordGlossary.description: Units with the SMOKE keyword can use the Core Smokescreen Stratagem (1 CP) in your opponent’s Shooting phase when targeted: until the end of the phase, all models in your unit have the Benefit of Cover and the Stealth ability (-1 to be Hit).

keywordGlossary.name: Psyker
keywordGlossary.summary: Wields Warp powers; vulnerable to [ANTI-PSYKER] weapons.
keywordGlossary.description: Psyker models channel the Warp to unleash Psychic weapons and abilities, and are susceptible to Anti-Psyker rules and defences.

keywordGlossary.name: Terminator
keywordGlossary.summary: Heavy tactical dreadnought armor; typically takes 2 spaces in compatible Transports and has a 2+ Save / 4+ Invulnerable Save.
keywordGlossary.description: Terminator Infantry wear Tactical Dreadnought Armour, granting deep strike teleportation and heavy resilience, while occupying 2 capacity slots in Transports that allow them.

keywordGlossary.name: Jump Pack
keywordGlossary.summary: High-mobility thrusters granting FLY and Deep Strike.
keywordGlossary.description: Jump Pack units are fast-moving assault troops with FLY and Deep Strike capabilities.

keywordGlossary.name: Gravis
keywordGlossary.summary: Heavy Mark X Gravis armor (T6); takes 2 spaces in compatible Space Marine Transports.
keywordGlossary.description: Mk X Gravis armour provides Toughness 6 and extra wounds for Space Marine infantry, occupying 2 slots in compatible Transports.

keywordGlossary.name: Phobos
keywordGlossary.summary: Stealth/recon Mark X Phobos armor; interacts with Infiltrators, Scouts, and vanguard redeployment rules.
keywordGlossary.description: Mk X Phobos armour is worn by Space Marine reconnaissance units, unlocking vanguard guerrilla Stratagems and abilities.

keywordGlossary.name: Tacticus
keywordGlossary.summary: Standard Mark X Tacticus power armor; compatible with Impulsor and standard Space Marine Transports.
keywordGlossary.description: Mk X Tacticus armour is worn by standard Primaris Space Marine squads, allowing embarkation in Impulsors, Repulsors, and Land Raiders.

keywordGlossary.name: Synapse
keywordGlossary.summary: Tyranid Hive Mind node: friendly Tyranids within 6" roll 3D6 for Battle-shock tests and gain +1 Melee Strength.
keywordGlossary.description: While a Tyranids unit is within 6" of one or more friendly Synapse models, it is within Synapse Range: it takes Battle-shock tests on 3D6 instead of 2D6, and adds 1 to the Strength characteristic of its melee weapons.

keywordGlossary.name: Damned
keywordGlossary.summary: Mortal Chaos cultists and renegades.
keywordGlossary.description: Identifies mortal Chaos Cultist, Traitor Guard, and Accursed units for Chaos Space Marines detachments and Stratagems.

keywordGlossary.name: Daemon
keywordGlossary.summary: Warp entity with invulnerable saves; interacts with Anti-Daemon rules.
keywordGlossary.description: Daemon units are manifestations of the Warp, typically possessing an invulnerable save and interacting with Daemonic Pact / Shadow of Chaos rules.

keywordGlossary.name: Imperium
keywordGlossary.summary: Super-faction keyword for armies of the Imperium of Man.
keywordGlossary.description: Denotes allegiance to the Imperium of Man, governing Imperial Agents and Freeblade Knight allies.

keywordGlossary.name: Chaos
keywordGlossary.summary: Super-faction keyword for armies of the Dark Gods.
keywordGlossary.description: Denotes allegiance to the Ruinous Powers of Chaos (Khorne, Tzeentch, Nurgle, Slaanesh), governing Daemonic Pact and Dreadblade allies.

keywordGlossary.name: Adeptus Astartes
keywordGlossary.summary: Faction keyword for Space Marines; unlocks Oath of Moment and Space Marine Stratagems.
keywordGlossary.description: Identifies Space Marine units eligible for the Oath of Moment army rule and Adeptus Astartes Detachment rules.
